BiblicalUsage: Meluwkah is a kingdom, a realm, the thing a king rules. 1 Chronicles 10:14 says God turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse, and 1 Kings 1:46 says Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom. 1 Samuel 10:16 has Saul keep silent about the matter of the kingdom Samuel spoke of, and 2 Kings 25:25 shows the kingdom's end, when Ishmael slew Gedaliah at Mizpah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe kingdoms are given and taken by the same hand: God turned Saul's kingdom to David, set Solomon on its throne, and let it fall at Mizpah when the people would not listen. My position is that no kingdom stands on its own strength, and the only throne that never moves is God's.
RelatedPeople: King David; King Solomon; King Saul
